CustomField.label: Relationship Key
CustomField.description: Computed by OI_HierarchyRelationshipService as hierarchyDefinitionId::parentRecordId::childRecordId (parentRecordId is the literal string "root" when blank) — enforces "duplicate parent-child relationships within the same hierarchy are prohibited" (FRD Business Rule 10) at the database level via a Unique/External ID constraint, while still allowing a child to have multiple DIFFERENT parents when Allow_Multiple_Parents__c is true (the key includes the parent, so only an exact duplicate pair collides).
